title: Understanding PostgreSQL MVCC: Tuple Headers and xmin / xmax
realWorldScenario: A software engineer asks how PostgreSQL allows readers to read data without locking out concurrent writers.
questionStatement: What is Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) in PostgreSQL? Explain how every row tuple uses hidden system columns `xmin` and `xmax` to determine visibility.
expectedConcepts: Readers do not block writers, writers do not block readers
hints: Think of UPDATE as inserting a new row and setting xmax on the old row.
